recap: Cavaliers lost to the Suns 134–118 in overtime.
Isaac Okoro led the Cavaliers with 32 points (10-16 FG, 3-4 3PT), 3 rebounds and 6 assists.
Devin Booker led the Suns with 31 points (14-27 FG, 1-6 3PT), 6 rebounds and 5 assists.
CLE won 2 of 4 factors: second chances, getting to the line. Effective FG% 52.8 to 58.1.
Biggest swing: Isaac Okoro makes 1-foot two point driving layup shot (Q4 59.1), +23 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): Osman, Allen, Dotson, Wade, Okoro, +2 in 10:28.
Bench points: CLE 17, PHX 34. Points in the paint: 54–70. Second-chance points: 15–15.
